title: English Practice Quiz 0258
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: They ___ football every Sunday.
questions.explanation: Use the base verb with the plural subject they in the present simple.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: Because I was tired, I went to bed early.
Because I tired, went bed early.
I because was tired bed early.
Because tired I went early bed.
questions.explanation: The subordinate clause beginning with because explains the reason.

questions.question: Which is a complete sentence?
questions.explanation: The team finished the work contains a subject and a complete predicate.

questions.question: Please drive ___.
questions.explanation: Carefully is the adverb modifying drive.

questions.question: What does 'borrow' mean?
options: take something temporarily and return it
questions.explanation: Borrow means to take something for a period and return it.

questions.question: Which word has a silent 'k'?
questions.explanation: The k in know is silent.

questions.question: If you heat ice, it ___.
questions.explanation: The zero conditional uses present simple for general truths.

questions.question: There ___ two chairs in the room.
questions.explanation: Use are with the plural noun chairs.

questions.question: Mount Everest is ___ highest mountain in the world.
A professional way to ask for a file is:
options: Could you please share the file?
questions.explanation: Could you please is a polite and professional request.
